title: 第7章 我会让你失去一切第8章 从此我来当家
slug: 狂仙出狱第2234章龙主燃尽
content_zh:
深夜，陈凡等疲惫的家人睡去后，在花城内转了好久也没找到适合修炼的地方，最后来到近郊的一处小湖边，才盘腿坐下。
随着陈凡进入修炼状态，周围的灵气都开始朝着他涌来。
“按照师父传授的秘法，我的身体的已经淬体了上百次，这才能明显感受到一些灵气所在。”
“这个世界的灵气太过稀薄了，想要加快修炼速度，要多找些上好的药材。”
“而我现在的身体可以完全将这些药材中富含的灵力吸收掉。”
陈凡一边想着，一边将崔富赠送的百年野山参拿了出来。
简单的做了一些准备工作后，陈凡贪婪的吸收着其中的灵力，如果此刻有其他人在场的话，那一定会被眼前的一幕所震撼！
因为此刻的陈凡全身都被白雾所笼罩，他所在的位置，宛如仙境一般。
随着陈凡的每一次呼吸，口鼻中都会吐出长长的白练。
等到清晨时分，陈凡缓缓睁开眼，惊喜地发现自己的修为已经从炼气七层达到了炼气十层！
只差一步，便可筑基！
“果然磨刀不误砍柴工，虽然花了两年多的时间不停用秘法淬体，但一切都是值得的！
一株百年药材就能让我修为提高这么多！”
陈凡心中狂喜，他已经沉淀够了，现在到了厚积而薄发的时候！
“爸妈和小怡应该也差不多醒了。”
陈凡算了算时间，正准备离开的时候，却怎料听到有人在背后叫他。
“陈凡？你怎么会在这里？这是你能来的地方吗？”
听着熟悉的声音，陈凡扭头望去，只见一名穿着最新款gucci绿色长裙，脖子上带着红宝石项链的年轻女子，正用疑惑、厌恶的目光盯着他。
“方婷。”
陈凡微微诧异。

他也没想到竟然会在这里遇到自己的前女友，三年前，两人分手了，原因是方婷告诉陈凡，自己爱上了别人。
陈凡平静地接受了这一切，因为他早就发现方婷是个很物质的女人，两人注定没有结局。
所以在方婷提出分手时，陈凡没有争吵，甚至也没有问对方爱上了谁，只是转身离开。
陈凡从未想过两人还会再见面，此刻方婷那一副高高在上的模样，让他觉得可笑。
“问你话呢？你怎么会在这里？我如果没有记错的话，你现在应该在监狱，不是吗？”
方婷见陈凡不说话，再次问道。
“你怎么会知道我入狱的事情？我们不是都已经结束了，你还会关注我？”
陈凡觉得有些蹊跷。
他不会天真的认为方婷对自己旧情难忘，拜金女脑中就只有钱。
果不其然，方婷听了陈凡的话，立刻露出一个嘲讽的笑容：“呵呵，我当然不会去关心你这种穷逼了，只不过……”
方婷话没说完，在不远处看到一个身影，立刻冲对方挥手叫道：“亲爱的，我在这里！
你看我见到谁了！”
她一边说着话，一边朝着对方走了过去，完全将陈凡视为空气。
陈凡回头看清男子的瞬间，顿时目光冷到了极点。
方婷口中的‘亲爱的’，正是三年前酒醉非礼陈凡妹妹的富二代，韩根硕！
此刻，韩根硕也认出了陈凡。
“嗯？你这垃圾怎么会在这里？你出狱了？这不可能啊。”
韩根硕也是一脸懵逼。
当初在陈凡入狱后，韩根硕为了整死他，动用财力将陈凡调去了宛如人间炼狱的九幽监狱。
content_en:
Late at night, after Chen Fan waited for his tired family to go to sleep, he walked around the flower city for a long time without finding a suitable place to practice. Finally, he came to a small lake in the suburbs and sat down cross-legged.
As Chen Fan entered the cultivation state, the spiritual energy around him began to surge towards him.
"According to the secret method taught by the master, my body has been tempered hundreds of times before I can clearly feel some spiritual energy."
"The spiritual energy in this world is too thin. If you want to speed up your cultivation, you need to find more good medicinal materials."
"And my current body can completely absorb the spiritual power rich in these medicinal materials."
Chen Fan was thinking as he took out the century-old wild ginseng presented by Cui Fu.
After making some simple preparations, Chen Fan greedily absorbed the spiritual power. If anyone else was present at this moment, they would definitely be shocked by the scene in front of them!
Because at this moment, Chen Fan's whole body was shrouded in white mist, and his location was like a fairyland.
With every breath Chen Fan took, long white strings would come out of his mouth and nose.
In the early morning, Chen Fan slowly opened his eyes and was pleasantly surprised to find that his cultivation level had reached the tenth level from the seventh level of Qi Refining!
There is only one step left to build the foundation!
"Sure enough, sharpening the sword is as good as chopping wood. Although it took more than two years to use secret methods to temper the body, it was all worth it!
A century-old medicinal plant can improve my cultivation so much! "
Chen Fan was ecstatic in his heart. He had settled down enough, and now it's time to accumulate more and lose his hair!
"My parents and Xiaoyi should be awake by now."
Chen Fan counted the time and was about to leave when he unexpectedly heard someone calling him from behind.
"Chen Fan? Why are you here? Is this a place you can come?"
Hearing the familiar voice, Chen Fan turned around and saw a young woman wearing the latest Gucci green dress and a ruby necklace around her neck, staring at him with confusion and disgust.
"Fang Ting."
Chen Fan was slightly surprised.
He didn't expect to meet his ex-girlfriend here. Three years ago, the two broke up because Fang Ting told Chen Fan that she fell in love with someone else.
Chen Fan accepted all this calmly, because he had long discovered that Fang Ting was a very materialistic woman, and the two of them were destined to have no ending.
So when Fang Ting proposed breaking up, Chen Fan didn't argue, and he didn't even ask who he fell in love with, he just turned around and left.
Chen Fan never thought that the two would meet again. At this moment, Fang Ting's condescending look made him feel ridiculous.
"Ask you? Why are you here? If I remember correctly, you should be in prison now, right?"
Seeing that Chen Fan was silent, Fang Ting asked again.
"How do you know that I'm in jail? We're not over it already, why would you still pay attention to me?"
Chen Fan felt a little strange.
He would not naively think that Fang Ting could never forget his old love, and that the money-worshiping girl only had money in her mind.
As expected, after hearing Chen Fan's words, Fang Ting immediately showed a sarcastic smile: "Haha, of course I won't care about a poor guy like you, but..."
Before Fang Ting finished speaking, she saw a figure not far away, and immediately waved to the other person and shouted: "Dear, I'm here!
Look who I saw! "
As she spoke, she walked towards the other party, completely treating Chen Fan as nothing.
The moment Chen Fan turned around and saw the man clearly, his eyes suddenly became extremely cold.
The 'honey' in Fang Ting's mouth is none other than the second-generation rich man, Han Keunshuo, who drunkenly molested Chen Fan's sister three years ago!
At this moment, Han Genshuo also recognized Chen Fan.
"Huh? Why are you here, you piece of trash? Are you out of jail? That's impossible."
Han Geun Suk was also confused.
After Chen Fan was imprisoned, Han Genshuo used financial resources to transfer Chen Fan to Jiuyou Prison, which was like a purgatory on earth in order to torture him to death.
